description: This file defines a utility class 'Utils' within the GuzzleHttp namespace, providing static methods for type description, header parsing, resource handling, environment-based handler selection, system CA bundle retrieval, header normalization, host proxy checks, JSON encoding/decoding with error handling, time measurement, and IDN URI conversion.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for type description, header parsing, resource handling, environment-based handler selection, system CA bundle retrieval, header normalization, host proxy checks, JSON encoding/decoding with error handling, time measurement, and IDN URI conversion.

methods.name: describeType
methods.description: Returns a string describing the type and class of the input variable.

methods.name: headersFromLines
methods.description: Parses header lines into an associative array of headers.

methods.name: debugResource
methods.description: Returns a resource for debugging based on the provided value.

methods.name: chooseHandler
methods.description: Selects and creates a default HTTP handler based on environment capabilities.

methods.name: defaultUserAgent
methods.description: Returns the default User-Agent string for Guzzle.

methods.name: defaultCaBundle
methods.description: Retrieves the default CA bundle path for the system, with caching.

methods.name: normalizeHeaderKeys
methods.description: Creates a mapping of lowercase header names to their original casing.

methods.name: isHostInNoProxy
methods.description: Checks if a host matches any no-proxy patterns.

methods.name: jsonDecode
methods.description: Decodes JSON string into PHP data, throwing on error.

methods.name: jsonEncode
methods.description: Encodes PHP data into JSON string, throwing on error.

methods.name: currentTime
methods.description: Returns current time as a float, using hrtime or microtime.

methods.name: idnUriConvert
methods.description: Converts a URI's host to ASCII-compatible encoding if needed.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Retrieves environment variable value from server or environment.
